subject.title: macOS app: dashboard fails silently with unresolved ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN} placeholder when env var not in app's environment, with no in-app recovery path

question: Which linked PR should become the canonical landing path for the macOS dashboard auth placeholder lockout?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but multiple open PRs overlap the same macOS auth resolver path and some only address the symptom; choosing the canonical implementation is a maintainer coordination decision.

options.title: Land the strongest native fallback fix
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading path once it is refreshed and has acceptable real macOS LaunchAgent proof.

options.title: Choose another linked PR
options.body: Use another open linked PR only if it provides cleaner upgrade behavior, stronger real app proof, or a better owner-boundary fix.

options.title: Ask for a replacement if candidates stall
options.body: Keep this issue open and create a narrow replacement only if the current linked PRs cannot become landable.

recommendation.title: Land the strongest native fallback fix
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading path once it is refreshed and has acceptable real macOS LaunchAgent proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a native macOS dashboard/GatewayEndpointStore landing-path choice, and steipete has the strongest recent history in that area.
